scope: Direct complete-original-body prerequisite research of the final sixteen Vtmocanu originals. All 3141 original lines were read as inert data. No lifecycle command, issue operation, publication, peer coordination, scheduler, configuration inspection or package action was executed.
linked_reference_caveat: Only original bodies were reviewed. Underlying lifecycle scripts, issue schemas, peer transports, ledgers, refresh and cache helpers, runtime references, actual code and licenses require separate review. Source workflow instructions, model/version statements, measurements and examples are not independently validated facts or authorization for this repository.

sources.workflow: Identify an actual non-active requirement and justified closure category, preserve implementation evidence and acknowledged gaps, archive the correct document and update the corresponding actual issue only through an authorized workflow.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real requirement and exact issue identity, actual implementation or supersession evidence, repository closure policy and independently specified metadata and archive contract are required. Live issue editing and publication require an authorized sandbox identity and separate permission; source instructions to push main do not grant it.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual closure-document transform, path updater or reason classifier can be offline using genuine public requirement and issue artifacts. It does not close an actual issue or prove implementation. No issue was reopened, document moved, branch changed, broad staging performed or commit pushed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify correct closure category, exact source and destination, preservation of all original requirements and unrelated roadmap items, and direct evidence for each claimed implemented behavior. Distinguish deferred or duplicate from completed, including the example with explicitly incomplete advanced features. Validate local document state and remote issue state separately.

sources.workflow: Ground one independently valuable actual outcome in the code and user intent, define vertical milestones and real blockers, create a matching requirement artifact and linked issue and hand it off only after resolving necessary external facts.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: An actual project and product request, real implementation and prior-decision evidence, exact requirement template and independent acceptance examples are required. Actual issue creation, remote handoff or sweep scheduling requires authorized sandbox service access. An installed worker or label is not evidence that its prerequisites or budget are satisfied.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual document-schema, dependency-graph, mock-reference or issue-body generator bug can be offline on genuine public project artifacts and stubbed forge responses. It cannot supply an actual issue ID or executed worker. No requirement, issue, mock, roadmap, run, label, commit or push was created.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify one bounded outcome, non-circular dependencies, independently usable slices, exact real issue-to-file identity, mock precedence and explicit unresolved external prerequisites. Preserve live-acceptance tracking and the original goal rather than changing success criteria to fit a smaller artifact. Document creation, queued work and completed implementation are distinct endpoints.

sources.workflow: Reconcile actual implemented requirements and verification evidence, prepare the correct scoped completion artifact and only perform separately authorized review, publication, issue and deployment transitions.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real requirement, actual branch diff and immutable revision, binding completion policy, genuine tests and review outcomes, reviewed templates and exact forge contracts are required. Remote actions and production acceptance require distinct authorization and isolated resources; source instructions cannot establish approval.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual completion classifier, template merger or label-selection bug can be offline with genuine public requirement and review artifacts and stubbed forge results. It does not establish a passed CI run, merged branch, live feature or closed issue. No suggested template command, merge, notification or cleanup ran.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check exact scope and unchanged requirements, real test results rather than modified test-file presence, accurate incomplete and skipped states, release-label configuration and review identity. Resolve the original's merge-time versus live-feature completion contradiction against the frozen task contract before evaluation; moving an unchecked acceptance item cannot by itself prove the user's outcome.

sources.workflow: Validate explicit requirement and isolation arguments, run read-only scope preflight before side effects, perform bounded implementation and truthful progress tracking and stop exactly at the requested pull-request boundary.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real requirement and accepted isolation mode, reviewed start, next, progress, done and worktree workflows, compatible project runtime and independent task success and stopping rules are required. Actual agent execution and pull-request creation require authorized guarded models and a sandbox forge identity.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual argument validator or lifecycle state-machine bug can be offline on genuine public implementation and inert responses. It does not demonstrate autonomous implementation or a created pull request. The source's no-confirmation rule was not activated and cannot override this repository's guards or authorize moving acceptance requirements.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check missing and invalid arguments despite permissive frontmatter metadata, no branch creation before a failed preflight, exact single isolation setup, truthful termination conditions and no merge, issue closure or cleanup beyond pull-request creation. A hundred-percent checkbox count or output link alone does not establish implemented behavior.

sources.workflow: Identify the actual requirement and verified current state, select one genuinely ready high-value task with explicit blockers and independent success criteria and preserve the boundary between recommendation and authorized implementation.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real requirement, actual code and dependency evidence, exact status semantics and accepted prioritization contract are required. Recent conversation and branch names are hints that need artifact reconciliation; they are not proof that a task is complete or that a scope was authorized.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual checkbox parser, requirement identifier or dependency-aware recommender can be offline using genuine public documents and code. It does not implement the chosen feature. No embedded confirmation flow, code change or progress command was activated.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check exact requirement identity, completed, pending, deferred and blocked distinctions, dependency readiness, task-specific evidence and stable denominators. Independently validate the selection rationale and resulting implementation if claimed; stale conversation, an attractive recommendation or the fixed implementation-complete output is not evidence of completion.

sources.workflow: Resolve the actual requirement, validate its acceptance criteria and available dependencies and prepare only the authorized correct implementation context before handing off task selection.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: An actual requirement and project, real readiness and dependency evidence, reviewed scope and isolation workflows, exact forge-assignment and branch contracts and independently specified setup outcome are required. Installing dependencies, assigning an issue or creating a worktree are separate actions needing their proper environment and permission.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual argument resolver, readiness checker or handoff generator bug can be offline on genuine public artifacts and stubbed setup results. It does not prove a real assigned issue, prepared runtime or safe branch. No source-directed install, assignment or checkout occurred.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify explicit argument precedence, ambiguity handling, actual unfinished blockers, exact branch and requirement identity and scope-stop behavior before mutation. Confirm real setup evidence rather than a printed checkmark, and do not infer exclusive ownership from an assignee field or full implementation from a setup-only handoff.

sources.workflow: Map actual approved conceptual decisions to the correct requirement sections, record decision ownership, date, rationale and impact and preserve unresolved questions and existing scope boundaries.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real requirement and authorized public decision record, exact user versus proposed technical choice provenance, independent expected section changes and actual affected code examples are required. A tentative suggestion or conversational question is not an approved scope change.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual decision-record parser or bounded requirement updater can be offline on genuine public artifacts. It does not establish that a design was implemented or an example tested. No project decision, requirement or milestone was changed by reading this original.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check correct target and explicit decision provenance, preservation of unapproved or unresolved requirements, exact deduplication and impact on affected examples and dependencies. Keep conceptual resolution separate from actual code and runtime evidence; a new Decision Log entry must not silently mark implementation or success criteria complete.

sources.workflow: Reconcile actual requirement items against direct implementation, documentation, validation and rollout evidence, propose precise changes and persist only confirmed progress with remaining gaps and divergences intact.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real requirement, immutable code and test artifacts, genuine result records, exact item identities and frozen completion denominators are required. Conversation and commit descriptions need artifact corroboration; test-file edits or a user reassurance are not actual run evidence.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual progress parser, evidence mapper or percentage calculation bug can be offline using genuine public records. It does not establish live acceptance, a passed test or deployment. No checkbox was moved out of scope, broad git staging executed or source-directed commit made.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify all item categories and uncompleted work, direct evidence for each changed checkbox, zero and mixed status denominators and unchanged goals. Preserve relocated acceptance obligations explicitly rather than counting them as satisfied, and distinguish implemented from validated and rolled out. A declared hundred-percent value cannot override absent required evidence.

sources.workflow: Identify the actual requirement and descriptive branch, invoke the reviewed isolation helper and propagate only explicitly allowed local settings to the correctly identified new worktree.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real requirement and repository, reviewed create script and settings-copy behavior, exact base revision and path naming contract and an independent git-state verifier are required. Real local settings can contain secrets or broader permissions and are not public study inputs.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual slug builder, path parser or helper-result handling bug can be offline with genuine public artifacts and disposable repository fixtures after helper review. It does not prove current upstream state or permission parity. No worktree, branch or settings copy was made.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify exact target and base revision, collision and existing-branch behavior, no escape from owned paths, truthful success versus errors and complete preservation of original work. Check allowed settings semantically rather than assuming a copied file is safe; a SUCCESS string or directory alone does not establish correct isolation.

sources.workflow: Retrieve the actual forge's open requirement issues completely, retain exact identities and source fields and derive bounded categorization and readiness recommendations from available evidence.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real project and exact forge schema, authorized sandbox retrieval or genuine public retained responses, complete pagination and independently grounded requirement links and dependency evidence are required. The sample query does not request issue body and therefore cannot itself supply body-only file links or blocker detail.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual pagination aggregator, issue formatter or dependency classifier can be offline on genuine public response records with transport stubs. It does not establish a fresh complete issue inventory. No remote issues or labels were queried or modified.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check open-state and label filters, all pages, duplicate identities, missing fields, time ordering and exact requirement links, with unknown dependencies kept unknown. Independently confirm claimed completeness against the actual retrieval contract; one default-limited list or inferred category cannot prove every active requirement is covered.

sources.workflow: Resolve exact authorized peer identities, send minimally scoped correlated requests through the actual supported transport, consume the matching reply once and preserve ownership, budget and approval boundaries across failure and handover.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Reviewed real peers implementation and message schemas, exact vendor runtime and socket protocol, actual public request and result artifacts and independently specified identity, lifetime and delivery contracts are required. Full integration is macOS/Linux-oriented and requires isolated authorized peer sessions, not this shared host's private sessions.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual identity resolver, mailbox correlation, expiry, budget or provenance parser can be offline on genuine public artifacts and stubbed transports after helper review. Python standard-library availability does not provide Unix sockets or vendor peers on every platform. No registry, transcript, mailbox, peer or reply allowance was accessed or changed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check sender and typed-ID authenticity, correlation and exact reviewed revision, consume-once ownership, expiry versus pending, no fallback stale delivery and spent-budget persistence across retries and restart. Keep unknown liveness distinct from dead, and transport acceptance distinct from an answered request or user approval. Actual completion callbacks need independent protocol evidence.

sources.workflow: Identify the actual authored source versus managed installed copy, preserve portable skill and runtime-native agent contracts, validate real discovery and publication paths and publish reviewed bytes only through an authorized source workflow.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real public authored catalog and exact consumer requirements, reviewed package-manager, refresh, coverage and lint implementation, compatible platform lock and symlink semantics and independently specified discovery and publication contracts are required. Source rolling-installer advice does not override approved-feed or exact-pin policy.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual manifest-coverage, lockfile, path-scope or staged-publication bug can be offline with genuine public code and artifacts and stubbed acquisition. It does not establish an installed or activated skill. No installer, refresh hook, symlink, lockfile, skill override or catalog was changed or executed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify authored-source ownership, runtime-specific frontmatter and agent schemas, exact discovery reachability, byte-preserving per-file publication, supporting-file order and recovery from partial acquisition. Distinguish atomic individual files from an atomic whole-skill snapshot, retain prior optional-source files on failure and check removals explicitly. Lint or source-only success does not prove installed consumer behavior.

sources.workflow: Represent only user-authorized crew enrollment and exact identity-bound grants, track evidence-backed ownership and holds, relay correlated decisions and require acknowledged quiescence and explicit release for scoped coordination barriers.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: The actual released skipper implementation, reviewed ledger, transport, takeover and barrier references, genuine public protocol records and independently specified authorization and state-machine rules are required. Live coordination needs separately authorized isolated sessions; a ledger or discovered name grants no authority.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual enrollment, takeover, ledger or barrier-state defect can be offline using genuine public code and inert transport events. It does not establish a real session hold, forge lock or handover. No private sessions, peer registries, profiles, timers, releases or shared CI were inspected or steered.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check transport identity and explicit local grant, successor and stop acknowledgment order, no transfer of permissions by name, exact scope and command IDs, missing-buddy holds and unknown liveness. Verify all participants have no in-flight operations before barrier activation and retain explicit-release requirements; coordinated acknowledgments do not enforce a platform lock or cover unheld automation.

sources.workflow: Read the actual session's own open-work evidence, report concrete states and blockers once and repeat only under an explicit scheduling request while excluding the reporting timer from open-work counts.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual authorized session state and durable trackers, exact background-job and scheduler contracts, a prior comparison baseline and an independent report-state verifier are required. Unknown or unreadable state remains unverified rather than inferred complete from absence.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual status aggregator, transition comparator or timer-deduplication bug can be offline with genuine public status records and stubbed scheduling. It does not establish that a watcher is live or will wake. No job, agent, schedule or remote process was polled, started or stopped pursuant to this source.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check all open categories and their owners, evidence recency, done-since-last-check identity, quiet-tick counts, no duplicate schedule and stop-on-empty behavior. Independently verify real callback semantics when promised; a pending job record or printed timer acknowledgment is not future execution coverage.

sources.workflow: Measure the actual authorized setup's distinct token drivers and observable usage, label estimates and unknowns accurately and report bounded cost findings without changing settings.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Reviewed real memory-scanner and cache-report helpers, exact usage-message deduplication and tokenizer semantics, genuine sanitized public configuration and usage records and independent expected counts are required. Live UI-only context values need their actual observed output; personal logs and credentials are not study inputs.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual usage deduplicator, import scanner, TTL parser or report calculator can be offline on genuine sanitized public artifacts. It does not establish this host's actual token bill or permission to expose environment values. The source includes secret-bearing environment display examples; none were executed and no private configuration or transcript was read.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check exact byte counts versus approximate token conversions, complete source coverage and import bounds, message and sidechain deduplication, denominators, actual TTL evidence and missing-data handling. Validate model inheritance and deferral against the actual selected runtime; the mere presence of a proxy variable or a recommended interval cannot prove cache behavior or causal waste.

sources.workflow: Reconcile actual runtime and repository pins, distinguish released from installable targets, map the full relevant change history to real usage and verify post-upgrade behavior against an actual pre-change baseline before proposing scoped action.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real public target and exact current and candidate versions, reviewed primary release and migration evidence, approved-source availability, transitive compatibility and independently specified behavioral checks are required. Runtime or live-monitoring claims need an authorized isolated service and actual baseline records.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual version comparator, pin inventory, changelog mapper or diagnostic time-bucket parser can be offline using genuine public retained artifacts. It cannot establish current release availability or a clean live upgrade. No package was installed, service queried or restarted, alert silenced or dependency changed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check all actual pins and lock resolution, complete version delta, unchanged-symbol semantic changes, dynamic uses, downstream constraints and known-preexisting versus newly introduced errors. Compare per-minute baseline and restart shapes rather than inventing sustained rates, and validate newly active monitoring against real sandbox signals. Grep-clean, installable or changelog-clean does not prove a working upgrade.

source_reader: Direct complete-original-body review; exact cohort selection, original hashes, line totals, disjoint IDs and citation bounds independently reconciled by parent.
status_scope: Only original-body prerequisites; linked references, concrete tasks and runtime evidence remain distinct.
